title: Katy experiments

dallas.role: clock + yes_bid path at the run mark
dallas.note: Dallas UI stays 2Q/3Q. Katy may read later 4Q path on the same 604 trades.

houston.note: Houston is declared inside Katy. It is not warehouse L2 and not a Kalshi taker fill.

austin.role: frozen hold-80-to-settlement EV at the run-mark snapshot. Model is not refit.
austin.optimize: threshold and price-range search only. Not a retrain.

experiments.title: Late underwater 41–70 / EV < 5
experiments.question: If FIRST80 is already on and yes_bid is 41–70 at 4Q 9:00 / 2H 7:30, does Austin EV < 5 plus a Houston taker lock cut loser damage?
experiments.one_line: Loser tails improve on A/NBA; net path EV loses to hold on all three books (A 2.9895833333333335 vs hold 4.375; B 2.0869565217391304 vs 2.608695652173913; NBA 2.781094527363184 vs 3.582089552238806).

experiments.title: Q4 12:00 / 2H 10:00 — range × Austin EV vs 80/40
experiments.question: At NBA Q4 12:00 / NCAAB 2H 10:00, what yes_bid range and Austin EV cutoff would let a Houston lock beat always-80/40 by cutting losers?
experiments.rule: Preregistered grid. PRICE_LO=41. PRICE_HI ∈ {50,55,60,65,70,75,79}. Austin EV < {-20,-10,0,5,10,15,20}. Maximize mixed 80/40 − always 80/40. Ties → fewer hedges, then tighter band.
experiments.one_line: A 41–75 / EV<-20.0 Δ0.625¢; B NONE; NBA 41–79 / EV<-20.0 Δ0.05970149253731343¢. Search ≠ freeze. Books never combined.

experiments.title: 2H last 10 — four-universe price hedge vs 80/40
experiments.question: On the locked NBA 2Q/3Q and NCAAB 1H/2H FIRST80 books, at 2H last 10 (NBA Q4 12:00 converted to that label; NCAAB 2H 10:00), what yes_bid range lets a Houston lock beat always-80/40 by cutting losers? No Austin.
experiments.rule: Independent price search. PRICE_LO=41. PRICE_HI ∈ {50,55,60,65,70,75,79}. Maximize mixed 80/40 − always 80/40. Ties → fewer hedges, then tighter band. No Austin EV.
experiments.one_line: NBA 2Q NONE; NBA 3Q 41–70 Δ0.7448275862068966¢; NCAAB 1H second 10 NONE; NCAAB 2H first 10 NONE. Search ≠ freeze. Books never combined.

experiments.title: 2H last 10 clock trail — 55 / 45 / 40 vs 80/40
experiments.question: On the locked NBA 2Q/3Q and NCAAB 1H/2H FIRST80 books, does a converted 2H last 10 clock trail (≤55 early, ≤45 mid, else 80/40) raise candle-path EV vs always-80/40? No Austin.

marks.nba: 2H last 10 = Q4 12:00; early ≤55 while rem>6:00; mid ≤45 from 6:00–3:00
marks.ncaab: 2H last 10 = 2H 10:00; early ≤55 while rem>5:00; mid ≤45 from 5:00–2:30

experiments.rule: Independent path trail. FIRST80 entry kept. T40 kept. Extra last-10 sells at 55 then 45. Houston lock is declared at the triggering close. No Austin EV.
experiments.one_line: NBA 2Q Δ-1.321656050955414¢ vs 80/40; NBA 3Q Δ0.5¢ vs 80/40; NCAAB 1H second 10 Δ0.5181347150259067¢ vs 80/40; NCAAB 2H first 10 Δ-1.9784172661870503¢ vs 80/40. Not a freeze. Books never combined.

experiments.title: 2H last 10 — four-book Austin range × EV vs 80/40
experiments.question: At 2H last 10 (NBA Q4 12:00 / NCAAB 2H 10:00), after examining losers, what yes_bid range and Austin EV cutoff lets a Houston lock beat always-80/40 on NBA 2Q, NBA 3Q, and NCAAB 1H/2H Discovery?
experiments.rule: Preregistered grid. PRICE_LO=41. PRICE_HI ∈ {50,55,60,65,70,75,79}. Austin EV < {-20,-10,0,5,10,15,20}. Maximize mixed 80/40 − always 80/40. Ties → fewer hedges, then tighter band. Austin not refit.
experiments.one_line: NBA 2Q 41–75 / EV<-20.0 Δ0.06070287539936102¢; NBA 3Q 41–79 / EV<5.0 Δ0.6620689655172414¢; NCAAB 1H Discovery 41–75 / EV<-20.0 Δ0.625¢; NCAAB 2H Discovery NONE. Search ≠ freeze. Books never combined.

note: Katy is a labeled research-experiment index. Each card is its own page. Houston lock is declared, not a fill. Experiments 1, 2, and 5 query frozen Austin. Experiments 3 and 4 do not. Confirmation unspent.
